messages:
maria: GuardDuty flagged a SG change in prod-us-east at 2026-02-10T13:15Z - sg-0a1b2c3d now allows 0.0.0.0/0 TCP 22. Detected by config-drift detector. I'm starting containment.
raj: On it. Which instance is behind that SG? Can we revoke the rule immediately via CLI?
maria: Instance tag service=ingest, id i-0f4e7c2a. CLI to revoke: `aws ec2 revoke-security-group-ingress --group-id sg-0a1b2c3d --protocol tcp --port 22 --cidr 0.0.0.0/0`
tessa: I attempted SSH to 3.12.45.6 before and after, can't reach now. Looks blocked. :thumbsup:
alex: Terraform drift? CloudTrail shows `AuthorizeSecurityGroupIngress` by `arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/terraform-runner` around 2026-02-10T12:58Z. That role ran in pipeline #562.
maria: CloudTrail snippet: `userIdentity: { type: "AssumedRole", arn: "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/terraform-runner" }, eventName: "AuthorizeSecurityGroupIngress"`
tessa: Pipeline logs: `pipeline/562 -> apply -> success` at 12:59 UTC. Approver was automated (ci-bot). No manual approval recorded.
raj: Immediate steps I took: revoked the 0.0.0.0/0 ingress (done), added an inline deny for that SG change to the terraform-runner role (temp), and paused the pipeline queue for that repo.
kayla: Legal/Compliance: any sign of data accessed or exfil? Need to know if customer data touched.
maria: No evidence of S3 or DB access from that instance in recent flow logs. VPC flow logs show no outbound to internet after revoke. Starting forensic snapshot of the instance and EBS volumes now. Preserving CloudTrail for 90d and exported to secure bucket.
sec-bot: Incident ticket created: INC-2026-143. Postmortem owners assigned: @maria, @raj. PagerDuty notified.
alex: Suggested action list: 1) revoke ingress (done) 2) restrict terraform-runner permissions and rotate its keys 3) re-run terraform plan with `-refresh` and require manual approval for SG changes 4) run host-level checks and image integrity
raj: I rotated pipeline role keys and added MFA/approval gate on the pipeline for prod. Also locked the Terraform state workspace to prevent concurrent applies.
tessa: Smoke tests for ingest passed after revoke. Running a full e2e ingest test now, will report if anything breaks. :eyes:
maria: Forensics: taking EBS snapshot (encrypted with KMS arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:123456789012:key/abcd-ef12), collecting `ps aux`, `netstat -tulpen`, and `/var/log/auth.log`. Snapshot will be S3-exported under object lock.
alex: Also enabling Config rule: `restrict-public-ports` and adding a detector to block `0.0.0.0/0` on privileged ports (22, 3389, 2376) with automated remediation.
kayla: Drafting a short customer-facing statement: "We detected a temporary security group misconfiguration that was contained within minutes. There is no evidence of data access. We are investigating and will follow up with a detailed report." Will share draft for review.
tessa: Post-incident action items I logged: - Enforce SCP denying public SGs - Add pre-apply check in TF to fail on public ingress - Add pipeline approval for infra changes to prod - Add GuardDuty/Config escalation to #incidents
maria: Agreed. Also add continuous guardrail: deny `AuthorizeSecurityGroupIngress` from terraform-runner unless change approved via ticket ID tag.
sec-bot: Follow-up meeting scheduled: 2026-02-12T16:00Z. Attendees: @maria @raj @alex @tessa @kayla
raj: Assigning PR to fix TF module (sg module defaulting to private rules) -> PR #1045, ETA EOD 2026-02-11.
maria: Thanks team. Closing the alert in GuardDuty once it stops triggering and we'll produce a full postmortem. Will update INC-2026-143 with findings and remediation timeline.
